body: We don't actually have an efficient, conservative SE -> SE regridder, so we never actually use `share_surface_space: false` in practice. The same is true for building a custom land space. To keep things simple, I removed this option (along with `h_elem_coupler` and `nh_ploy_coupler`) and cleaned up anything that dealt with general SE spaces.
title: Remove land and coupler space flexibility
